short_description: Azure hosted inventory portal returns intermittent errors
description: The inventory portal loads normally at first but returns HTTP 502 errors several times an hour. Staff at two offices see the same behavior, while other internal websites remain available.
resolution_summary: Corrected an Azure Application Gateway backend health probe that was checking an obsolete application path. Verified that both backend instances remained healthy.

short_description: Overnight export cannot save files to Azure storage
description: The scheduled analytics export has failed to write its output to an Azure storage container for two nights. Interactive reporting still works, and the job log records an authorization failure during file upload.
resolution_summary: Renewed an expired storage access signature in the export job configuration and verified a successful upload.

short_description: Shipment tracking service repeatedly restarts
description: Shipment status updates are delayed in the internal tracking portal. The service dashboard shows repeated container restarts in the Azure Kubernetes Service cluster after the latest deployment, but no clear error appears in the portal.
resolution_summary: Raised the container memory limit after confirming memory termination events in Kubernetes. Verified stable pods and successful processing of the queued updates.

short_description: Azure Virtual Desktop session fails before desktop appears
description: Users selecting the warehouse desktop receive a message that no resources are available. Authentication completes successfully, and the issue affects everyone using this desktop pool this morning.
resolution_summary: Corrected a failed session host registration in the Azure Virtual Desktop host pool and restored the affected hosts to service. Verified new sessions could start.

short_description: Test environment virtual machine unavailable after reboot
description: A shared Azure virtual machine used for integration testing no longer responds after its scheduled reboot. Other machines in the same environment are reachable, and the Azure console shows the affected machine is running.
resolution_summary: Used Azure serial console access to correct an invalid filesystem mount entry that prevented normal boot. Restarted the machine and verified application availability.

short_description: Report downloads stall during peak processing
description: The reporting portal accepts requests but large downloads time out during the afternoon processing window. Smaller reports usually succeed, and users working from home and the office report the same delays.
resolution_summary: Identified sustained disk throughput limits on the Azure worker virtual machine. Increased the managed disk performance tier and verified large report downloads during a processing run.

short_description: New starter cannot sign in to internal services
description: A newly created test account cannot sign in to the staff portal or Microsoft Teams. Both show that access is blocked, although the account appears in the directory and its temporary password is accepted.
resolution_summary: Enabled the account in Microsoft Entra ID after confirming its onboarding status. Verified successful sign-in to both services.

short_description: Repeated authentication prompts after phone replacement
description: A staff member using a synthetic test account receives repeated verification prompts when opening Microsoft 365 applications after replacing their phone. Their password works, but they cannot complete the second authentication step.
resolution_summary: Removed the obsolete Microsoft Authenticator registration and completed a new multifactor authentication registration. Verified sign-in with the replacement device.

short_description: VPN sign-in rejected before connection starts
description: The VPN client rejects a pilot account immediately after the browser sign-in step. The account can open the staff portal, and another test account on the same laptop can connect through the VPN client.
resolution_summary: Restored the pilot account's membership in the Entra ID group authorized for the VPN enterprise application. Verified that application assignment and VPN authentication succeeded.

short_description: Procurement portal enters a sign-in loop
description: Opening the procurement portal redirects repeatedly between its login page and the organizational sign-in page. The issue began this morning for all pilot accounts, while other single sign-on applications remain accessible.
resolution_summary: Updated the procurement enterprise application's expired SAML signing certificate in coordination with the application configuration. Verified that a new sign-in completed without a redirect loop.

short_description: Azure Virtual Desktop access blocked at sign-in
description: Several pilot accounts receive an access policy error before reaching the Azure Virtual Desktop resource list. The same accounts can access email, and affected users report the problem from compliant managed laptops.
resolution_summary: Corrected the scope of a Microsoft Entra Conditional Access policy that unintentionally blocked the desktop pilot accounts. Verified successful access from compliant managed devices.

short_description: Approved project members cannot open shared workspace
description: Two test accounts added to a project yesterday still receive access denied when opening the project workspace. Existing members can open it, and the new accounts can access other workspaces normally.
resolution_summary: Corrected a dynamic membership rule in the Entra ID group granting workspace access. Confirmed group membership processing and verified access for both accounts.

short_description: VPN connects but internal sites do not load
description: Remote users can establish a VPN session and access public websites, but internal sites time out. The issue affects multiple managed devices and began after the overnight maintenance window.
resolution_summary: Restored a missing internal subnet route in the VPN gateway configuration. Verified access to the affected internal sites through a remote connection.

short_description: Office users cannot reach the service portal by name
description: The service portal opens from home but fails to load by its normal hostname at one office. Other external websites work, and several workstations in that office show the same behavior.
resolution_summary: Corrected a stale record on the office DNS resolver and cleared its cached response. Verified that the portal hostname resolved to the current address.

short_description: Teams calls break up on one office floor
description: Microsoft Teams calls on the third floor have choppy audio and intermittent frozen video. The same laptops work normally on other floors, and wired users on the affected floor report similar call quality problems.
resolution_summary: Replaced a faulty switch uplink module that was causing packet loss. Confirmed normal link error counters and stable Teams calls on the affected floor.

short_description: Branch users lose access to hosted order application
description: The order application times out for everyone in one branch while other locations can still use it. General internet access at the branch is working, and the issue started shortly after scheduled firewall maintenance.
resolution_summary: Restored a firewall rule allowing the branch subnet to reach the hosted application's HTTPS endpoint. Verified successful connections from the branch.

short_description: Wireless devices repeatedly disconnect in training rooms
description: Managed laptops disconnect from the wireless network every few minutes in two training rooms. Reconnecting works briefly, and the same devices remain connected in the main office area.
resolution_summary: Resolved overlapping channel assignments and excessive interference on the training room wireless access points. Verified stable connectivity during a full training session.

short_description: Desktop sessions freeze during busy office hours
description: Azure Virtual Desktop sessions become unresponsive for several seconds at a time from one office during late morning. Home users on the same desktop pool do not report the issue, and office users also notice slow file transfers.
resolution_summary: Adjusted traffic prioritization and removed an unintended bandwidth cap on the office WAN circuit. Verified stable desktop sessions while file transfers were active.

short_description: One laptop cannot open the VPN client
description: The VPN client closes immediately when launched on a managed laptop. Other applications work, and another laptop using the same test account can start the VPN client and connect successfully.
resolution_summary: Repaired the damaged VPN client installation and restarted its local service. Verified that the client launched and established a connection.

short_description: Teams microphone unavailable on a managed laptop
description: Microsoft Teams reports that no microphone is available on one laptop even though the headset works on another device. Restarting Teams and joining a different meeting do not change the result.
resolution_summary: Enabled microphone access in the device privacy settings and reinstalled the headset driver. Verified audio capture in a Teams test call.

short_description: Virtual desktop client shows a blank window
description: The Azure Virtual Desktop client displays a blank window on one workstation after an update. The same test account can open its desktop through a browser and from another workstation.
resolution_summary: Cleared the local desktop client cache and repaired the client installation. Verified that the workspace feed and desktop session opened normally.

short_description: Documents remain queued on one workstation
description: Print jobs from one workstation remain in the local queue and never reach the shared printer. Other workstations can print to that printer, and the affected device has the same problem from several applications.
resolution_summary: Cleared a blocked local print spooler queue and reinstalled the approved printer driver. Verified printing from two applications.

short_description: Workstation becomes slow shortly after sign-in
description: A managed workstation takes several minutes to open applications after each sign-in. The issue affects all test accounts on that device, while nearby workstations running the same applications remain responsive.
resolution_summary: Removed obsolete local update cache files that had exhausted disk space and completed pending updates. Verified normal application startup after a restart.

short_description: External monitors remain blank after docking
description: A laptop detects its docking station but both external monitors remain blank. The laptop screen works, and the monitors display correctly when connected to a different laptop using the same dock.
resolution_summary: Updated the laptop graphics driver and docking station firmware to the approved compatible versions. Verified both external displays after docking and rebooting.

short_description: Teams channel messages fail for all channel members
description: Members of one Microsoft Teams channel cannot post new messages and see a notice that the channel is read-only. Other channels in the same team work, and the behavior is consistent on desktop and web clients.
resolution_summary: Removed an unintended channel moderation restriction that prevented members from posting. Verified new messages from a standard member account.

short_description: Meeting room calendar rejects new reservations
description: A shared meeting room declines all new bookings even when its calendar shows free time. The problem occurs for several organizers, while booking other rooms works normally.
resolution_summary: Corrected the room mailbox booking policy that had restricted the booking window to zero days. Verified that an available reservation was accepted.

short_description: Shared mailbox no longer receives external messages
description: External test messages to the shared purchasing mailbox are rejected, while messages from internal accounts arrive normally. Other shared mailboxes can receive external mail without an issue.
resolution_summary: Removed an unintended internal-senders-only delivery restriction on the Exchange Online shared mailbox. Verified delivery from an external synthetic test sender.

short_description: SharePoint library opens but documents cannot be uploaded
description: Project members can read files in a SharePoint document library but new uploads fail with a storage message. The issue occurs in the browser and through synchronization, while other project sites accept uploads.
resolution_summary: Increased the affected SharePoint site's storage quota within the allocated tenant capacity. Verified document uploads through the browser and synchronization client.

short_description: Teams meeting invitations lack a join link
description: New meetings created through a shared scheduling calendar do not include a Teams join link. Existing online meetings still work, and the issue occurs for all delegates using that calendar.
resolution_summary: Corrected the online meeting policy for the licensed scheduling account and refreshed its calendar integration. Verified a new invitation contained a working Teams join link.

short_description: Departed project site still appears read-only for members
description: A project site reopened for a new work phase remains read-only for every member. Members can open its files but cannot edit pages or documents, including through the web interface.
resolution_summary: Removed the archived SharePoint site's read-only lock after confirming the approved reopening request. Verified document editing and page updates.

short_description: Purchase orders fail at final approval
description: Approvers can review purchase orders in the procurement application but receive a validation error when submitting final approval. Draft creation works, and the problem affects orders using a newly introduced cost center.
resolution_summary: Added the missing cost center mapping to the procurement approval workflow configuration. Verified approval of a synthetic order using the new cost center.

short_description: Expense application reports duplicate submissions
description: The expense application rejects new claims as duplicates even when the reference number has not been used. Several pilot accounts see the issue after the latest application release, while previously saved claims remain viewable.
resolution_summary: Corrected the claim reference generation logic introduced by the release and deployed the application fix. Verified that distinct synthetic claims received unique references.

short_description: Customer portal sign-in succeeds but dashboard fails
description: Test users can sign in to the customer service portal but see an application error instead of their dashboard. The problem affects accounts linked to one synthetic account category, while other test accounts load normally.
resolution_summary: Corrected the portal dashboard query to handle an empty optional category field. Verified dashboard rendering for affected and unaffected synthetic account categories.

short_description: Inventory screen shows outdated stock quantities
description: The inventory application displays yesterday's stock quantities although today's warehouse transactions are visible in the transaction list. Refreshing the page and using a different workstation show the same outdated totals.
resolution_summary: Restarted a stalled application aggregation job after correcting its invalid processing checkpoint. Rebuilt the stock summary and verified it matched the synthetic transaction records.

short_description: Monthly finance report omits one business unit
description: The monthly finance report completes without an error but leaves out one synthetic business unit. The underlying entries are visible in the finance application, and reports for earlier months include that unit.
resolution_summary: Updated the reporting configuration to include the business unit's new organizational code. Regenerated the monthly report and reconciled its totals against synthetic source entries.

short_description: Order entry page freezes when adding a product
description: The order entry page stops responding when a particular synthetic product is added to an order. Other products work, and the issue can be reproduced in multiple browsers by different test accounts.
resolution_summary: Corrected an invalid unit conversion rule in the application's product configuration. Verified the affected product could be added and the order saved.
